extractions.value: Patient had intellectual disability. Initial presentation was catatonia with Bush-Francis Catatonia Rating Scale score of 24. Exposure to multiple antidopaminergic medications (quetiapine, paliperidone) complicated the presentation; drug-induced parkinsonism was initially considered. EEG showed mild diffuse slowing. No EMG was performed. The paper notes this is the first published case of SPS/PERM presenting as catatonia.
